author: Leila Gharani
description:
Did your Desktop icons suddenly get green ticks, or is OneDrive constantly warning you that your storage is full? Windows 11 quietly moves your local folders into the cloud by default.

You can easily take control back and move your files to your local PC. However, the settings screen is a trap - clicking the wrong button can wipe your local folders entirely. In this video, I’ll show you the exact, safe method to stop OneDrive backup without losing any data. Already clicked the wrong option? I’ve got you covered on how to recover your missing files.
